async def act(page):
    # Locate the 'Project name' textbox within the group
    project_name_field = page.get_by_role('group').get_by_role('textbox', name='Project name')
    # Get the current value of the textbox
    current_title = await project_name_field.input_value()
    # Check if the current title is already 'Title Wanted'
    if current_title != 'Title Wanted':
        # Clear the existing text and fill with 'Title Wanted'
        await project_name_field.clear()
        await project_name_field.fill('Title Wanted')
        # Locate the 'Save changes' button, using the first one under 'main' to avoid ambiguity
        save_button = page.get_by_role('main').get_by_role('button', name='Save changes').first
        await save_button.click()
        # Wait for the save operation to complete
        await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
        return 'Title updated to "Title Wanted".'
    else:
        return 'Title is already "Title Wanted". No update needed.'
